eligibility.methodological_eligibility.quote: The method for calculating annual energy savings involves evaluating the difference between the energy consumption before the implementation of the optimization action and the future energy consumption after applying the energy saving strategy.
eligibility.methodological_eligibility.rule: §5.2: consumo pre-implementacao serve de referencia (EnB no sentido ISO 50001/50002), com variaveis e forma funcional dadas.
